title: The ISSO must report all suspected violations of IA policies in accordance with DoD information system IA procedures.
check_content:
Interview the application representative and review the SOPs to ensure that violations of IA policies are analyzed and reported.
 
If there is no policy for reporting IA violations, this is a finding.
fixtext: Create and maintain a policy to report IA violations.
VulnDiscussion: Violations of IA policies must be reviewed and reported. If there are no policies regarding the reporting of IA violations, IA violations may not be tracked or addressed in a proper manner.
